comparison.objective: Orient and mount a tower CPU cooler so its offset fins clear tall memory.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation reasoning, bulky-part alignment, insertion/mounting, and clearance management.
comparison.success_condition: Cooler is mounted in the sole clearance-compatible orientation. Fastener, clearance, and damage thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: This tests orientation-dependent assembly and clearance, not impact fracture through a mandrel or recovery of four freely released metal fragments.
